-By default, OnnxLift will generate the weights in separate files. Yet, you can instruct the tool to generate those in a single file.
-The option `single` guides OnnxLift to generate the weights aggregated inside a single `.onnx_data` file.
-
-For example, the `AllMiniLmL6V2EmbeddingModel` was generated through `OnnxLift` from the [all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model.onnx source](https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/all-MiniLM-L6-v2-ONNX) and then manually enhanced to its current form:
-
-```shell
-JAVA_HOME=<path to the Babylon JDK home>
-mvn package exec:java -Dexec.mainClass=oracle.code.onnx.lift.OnnxLift -Dexec.args="<model.onnx> src/test/resources/oracle/code/onnx/bert AllMiniLmL6V2EmbeddingModel single"
-```
\ No newline at end of file
